title: Region
description: A region with its content version and region-wide simulation rule constants (MECHANICS §1, §3).

growth_per_min.description: Residents per minute a house gains at satisfaction 1 (MECHANICS §6.1).

decline_per_min.description: Residents per minute lost per unit of satisfaction below the threshold.

optional_tax_bonus.description: Maximum tax bonus of fully met optional needs (0.25 = +25 %).

auto_resume_upkeep_minutes.description: Gold reserve, in minutes of a building's upkeep, required before an unpaid building is auto-resumed (MECHANICS §7). Strictly positive: the reserve is the hysteresis that prevents pause/resume flapping.

ship_handling_base_seconds.description: Fixed part of the time a ship occupies a berth to unload and load (MECHANICS §9.2, §9.3).

ship_handling_seconds_per_unit.description: Additional handling time per unit of goods moved (unloaded plus loaded) at a stop (MECHANICS §9.2).

ship_speed_tiles_per_min.description: Archipelago tiles a ship of speed 1.0 covers per minute; travel time = distance / (speed x this), rounded up to whole milliseconds.

trial_resume_upkeep_minutes.description: Gold reserve, in minutes of an unpaid building's upkeep, after which it is trial-resumed even though the recomputed balance with it running is negative; it is paused again by the normal cascade if the balance stays negative. Strictly greater than auto_resume_upkeep_minutes.

away_summary_minutes.description: Minimum world time between the player's last command and a request for the server to produce a 'while you were away' summary.

camera.description: Client view constants of the region (render only, no rule reads them).

max_half_extent.description: Largest camera half-extent in tiles (the zoom-out cap); the client never caps below its far-LOD reach.
